Phase-2.name: Documentation and dogfooding
Phase-2.description: Wave 2: make every documented claim true, let the repository govern itself (docs/ + contracts + trust), and replace the cosmetic demo with realistic code and honest metrics.

step-1.description: W2.1 documentation truth pass: single source for counts, commands, MCP names with host prefix, honest metrics (docs-impl).

step-2.description: W2-pre security and contribution docs: SECURITY.md threat model, CONTRIBUTING.md release gates, issue/PR templates, architecture page (docs-impl).

step-3.description: W2.2 dogfooding: docs/ knowledge graph for every src module, contracts, plans, verification, trust and verify proof (core-impl, this repository).

step-4.description: W2.3 realistic demo project with real logic and real failure tests, generated from verification scenarios (quality-impl).

step-5.description: W2.3 honest metrics (documented line model and token proxy) plus a reproducible 12/50/200-module size sweep.

outcome.item-1: README, AGENTS.md, skills and templates describe only implemented behaviour; counts are auto-verified in CI.
outcome.item-2: This repository passes `mygrace lint --path . --strict` on itself and stores a valid, gitignored trust record.
outcome.item-3: examples/demo-store contains real logic, real failure tests and docs inside the configured budgets.
outcome.item-4: Documented savings are a labelled line/token model reproducible by scripts/measure-context.ts.

deliverables.item-1: docs/graph-index.xml, docs/modules/M-*.xml, docs/verification-index.xml and docs/verification/V-M-*.xml for every src module.
deliverables.item-2: docs/plan-index.xml plus Phase-1/2/3 plans that match ROADMAP waves and real status.
deliverables.item-3: docs/requirements.xml and docs/technology.xml grounded in the actual product and dependencies.
deliverables.item-4: AGENTS.md rewritten for the index-first workflow and the trust model; SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/architecture.md published.
deliverables.item-5: CI job that runs validate-docs so a stale count or command cannot silently ship.

acceptance-gates.item-1: mygrace lint --path . --strict exits 0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings on this repository.
acceptance-gates.item-2: mygrace trust --path . followed by mygrace verify --path . --module M-LINT executes the real test command and exits 0.
acceptance-gates.item-3: mygrace status --path . reports module, phase and verification counts that match the indexes at the end of this phase.
acceptance-gates.item-4: scripts/validate-docs.ts and scripts/validate-marketplace.ts are green in CI.

evidence.item-1: AGENTS.md sha256 is identical before and after setup init without --force (the existing file must be preserved).
evidence.item-2: mygrace inspect module show M-XML and mygrace context packet M-LINT read the new docs successfully.
evidence.item-3: bun test remains green after the documentation work (no test was changed to fit docs).

risks.item-1: Docs can re-drift after later waves land; validate-docs must stay in the CI gate.
risks.item-2: The demo is generated; a generator bug must fail CI rather than silently weaken lint.
risks.item-3: Trust records are local state; committing one would defeat the security model.

dependencies.item-1: Phase-1 gate: full test suite green, strict typecheck clean, demo lint --strict 0/0, pack-smoke green.
dependencies.item-2: docs-impl owns README/AGENTS/skills/templates; core-impl owns docs/** and the src contracts.
dependencies.item-3: quality-impl owns scripts/validators, the CI workflow and the demo generator.
dependencies.item-4: Changing any docs/modules, docs/verification or config file invalidates `.mygrace/trust.json`; re-run `mygrace trust`.
